$comment: How the checker reads a Gorgias view export. Edit this file, then run `npm run rules` so the page and the CLI pick it up. Header names and AI Agent tags come from a Gorgias trial account (Nov 2, 2026) and the Gorgias docs. Anything marked UNVERIFIED has not been seen in a real export with AI Agent traffic.

contactReason.note: Account-specific dropdown; used as extra text for categories. UNVERIFIED in real data.

firstMessage.note: A view export has no message text. Left empty until a real export with a first-message column is seen.

tagSeparatorNote: UNVERIFIED: commas assumed, as in the Closewell importer.

notes.ai_close: AI Agent resolved the ticket on its own (Gorgias docs).
notes.ai_handover: AI Agent handed the ticket to the team. Wins over ai_close: a handover means a human got the ticket.
notes.ai_snooze: AI Agent snoozed the ticket waiting for the customer.
notes.ai_processing: AI Agent is still working on the ticket.
notes.ai_answered: UNVERIFIED on the trial; in the Gorgias docs. AI replied but neither closed nor handed over.
notes.ai_ignore: AI Agent skipped the ticket (a rule told it not to answer). Not counted as AI-handled.

outcomeField.note: UNVERIFIED guess at 'AI Agent Outcome' values, used only when a ticket has no AI tag.
